name: lumiant
description: Lumiant inventory intelligence platform — convenience scripts for the API (uv) and web app (pnpm).

scripts.check:api: uv --directory services/api run ruff check . && uv --directory services/api run ruff format --check . && uv --directory services/api run mypy
scripts.check:web: pnpm --dir apps/web lint && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run check:api && pnpm run test:api && pnpm run check:web && pnpm run test:web
